channel.title: Hermes Atlas — new projects
channel.description: Newly added community-built tools, skills, plugins, and integrations for Nous Research's Hermes Agent. Updated daily.

item.title: fnos-hermes-agent (Integrations & Bridges)
item.description: Hermes Agent for fnOS is an AI assistant application for Feiniu NAS, deployed through the fnOS app center as an .fpk package. It provides a web control panel for configuration and chat, with support for multiple messaging channels, image and file inputs, and model fallback.

item.title: hermes-agent-template (Deployment & Infra)
item.description: This Railway template deploys Hermes Agent with a web admin dashboard for configuring providers, channels, and tools, and managing the gateway and user pairing. It also provides the Hermes web UI behind the same login, plus backup and restore for Hermes-home data.

item.title: tutti (Multi-Agent & Orchestration)
item.description: Tutti is a real-time shared workspace that connects agents’ context, files, apps, and tasks. It supports connecting existing agents and using existing subscription credits; the open-source version also includes built-in apps. The README describes Tutti · VM as adding features such as group chat and simultaneous editing.

item.title: Orkas (Multi-Agent & Orchestration)
item.description: Orkas is an open-source, local-first desktop app where a Commander plans work and delegates tasks to built-in specialists and supported local agents. Projects retain goals, rules, memory, and files across conversations; to-dos, auto-advance, and scheduled automations help ongoing work continue.

item.title: oh-my-hermes (Multi-Agent & Orchestration)
item.description: oh-my-hermes is an operating layer for Hermes Agent that routes work to skills and model chains by category and runs graph-based tasks in parallel. It includes a TUI, task-ranked long-term memory, and status reporting that distinguishes reported completion from verified work.

item.title: memmy-agent (Memory & Context)
item.description: Memmy is a desktop app and CLI/TUI for local memory and AI-agent tasks. Its Memory Service stores and retrieves information, while its agent features can carry project context between supported tools, including Claude Code, Codex, OpenClaw, and Hermes.

item.title: hermes-project-stewardship (Developer Tools)
item.description: Hermes Project Stewardship lets a team of Hermes agents manage a project over time by checking project state, proposing evidence-backed work, and measuring outcomes. It provides a desktop app with project views, Kanban, workflows, approvals, and per-project memory, while allowing people to set autonomy and approval policies.

item.title: llm-judge-jury-executioner (Multi-Agent & Orchestration)
item.description: A standalone skill and CLI that runs questions through multiple independent models using six protocols, including voting, synthesis, critique, red-team review, and full deliberation. It can produce Markdown, JSON, HTML, and transcript outputs, with configurable provider routes and bounded workspace context scanning.

item.title: hermes-walkie-talkie (Integrations & Bridges)
item.description: Hermes Walkie Talkie is a standalone plugin that lets independent Hermes sessions on the same computer discover one another and coordinate through messages, groups, broadcasts, and structured requests. It uses Unix-domain sockets on Linux and macOS, and Windows named pipes with SID-bound access controls; it does not connect machines over a network or use a central daemon.

item.title: hermes-talk (Plugins & Extensions)
item.description: Hermes Talk is a voice plugin for Hermes Agent that lets users speak with the agent, hear spoken replies, and use its tools during a conversation. It supports terminal, Discord voice, dashboard, and Hermes Desktop sessions, with voice options including OpenAI Realtime, xAI Grok Voice, Gemini Live, GPT-Live, and Cascade voice; provider availability varies by surface.

item.title: Hermes Bot Kit (Workspaces & GUIs)
item.description: Hermes Bot Kit provides desktop plugins that add texting-style bubbles, named bot sections, a Tasks list, and a docked remote-desktop pane to Hermes Desktop. It also includes agent plugins for texting-style replies and for shell and GUI interaction with a bot’s pinned computer.

item.title: paperclip-hermes-file-access-manager (Plugins & Extensions)
item.description: File Access Manager is a Paperclip plugin that sets per-path Read/Write, Read Only, or Denied permissions for Hermes profiles. It translates those rules into Docker bind mounts and uses Hermes’ Docker terminal backend to enforce access inside a container. The plugin provides a filesystem tree editor, previews generated mounts, and can apply changes by recreating the container and restarting the gateway.

item.title: linkedin-skills (Skills & Skill Registries)
item.description: LinkedIn Marketing Skills for Claude Code and Codex is a collection of 12 skills for drafting LinkedIn posts, comments, and replies, reviewing drafts, planning content, and editing profiles. The skills show a draft and wait for approval before publishing; the README also documents installation for Hermes Agent and other tools that read SKILL.md files.

item.title: webly-plugin (Plugins & Extensions)
item.description: Webly provides an agent skill and plugins for publishing a folder or website to a live Webly URL without an account. Users can claim a site by signing in, then work with it through Webly’s MCP server, including editing and publishing.

item.title: doom-pay (Developer Tools)
item.description: DoomPay provides checkout and payment-verification tools for DOOM and wDOOM. The README describes an HTML checkout, a hosted checkout sessions API, a Python SDK, and an MCP server for payment verification.

item.title: github-bounty-scanner (Developer Tools)
item.description: `github-bounty-scanner` queries GitHub’s Issue Search API for open bounty issues and audits matches using `bounty-guard`. It classifies results as escrow-backed, legitimate issues without escrow, or quarantined, and can be run with Python 3 using only the standard library.

item.title: doomsday (Domain Applications)
item.description: Doomsday is a Proof-of-Work cryptocurrency designed to mine on consumer GPUs when a computer is idle, pausing mining when the user interacts with it. The project also provides a Windows desktop client, a live network dashboard, and a 1:1 bridge between DOOM and wDOOM on Base Mainnet.

item.title: cuda-gpu-miner (Developer Tools)
item.description: The repository provides a standalone Python pool miner for Doomsday Network and documents CUDA GPU mining through the network’s separate miner. It also describes a quickstart for generating a wallet and benchmarking DoomHash, plus Docker and cloud GPU deployment instructions.

item.title: web3-agent-skills (Skills & Skill Registries)
item.description: Web3 Agent Skills is a zero-dependency skill pack for AI coding assistants and agents, with files such as SKILL.md, .cursorrules, CLAUDE.md, and a remote MCP configuration. It supports checking GitHub bounty escrow status, querying the Doomsday Network MCP server, and mining DOOM or wDOOM pool shares.

item.title: bounty-guard (Skills & Skill Registries)
item.description: BountyGuard is a zero-dependency Python CLI, library, and MCP toolkit for screening GitHub repositories and issues for prompt-injection and other bounty-related risks. It classifies issues by repository risk and verified escrow status, and includes tools for checking escrow and maintaining a honeypot database.

item.title: deed-page-skill (Skills & Skill Registries)
item.description: This repository contains an agent skill that publishes a file or folder to a permanent deed.page URL using one curl request. It also documents deed.page’s hosted remote MCP server and provides plugin manifests and installation instructions for several agents.

item.title: lithermes (Plugins & Extensions)
item.description: LitHermes is a plugin for Hermes Agent that starts a workflow when a request begins with `lit`. It plans the task, checks the result, and records goals, plans, and evidence on disk; `/lit-handoff` creates a `HANDOFF.md` note so a later session can continue.

item.title: hermes-model-switcher (Workspaces & GUIs)
item.description: Hermes Model Switcher is a community plugin for the Hermes Web Dashboard that displays supported model routes across profiles in a searchable, filterable table. Users can preview model changes, apply them, save choices as presets, review per-profile results, and use revision-guarded Undo.

item.title: mcp (Integrations & Bridges)
item.description: Arcmira provides a remote MCP server for searching YouTube and podcast transcripts, retrieving timestamped passages, reading surrounding transcript lines, and finding mentions, appearances, endorsements, ad reads, sponsors, and mention trends. Agents can also set up YouTube monitors; the README describes sign-in through an MCP host or authentication with an account key.

item.title: kisscode-agent (Skills & Skill Registries)
item.description: This repository provides a skill for AI agents to join KissCode, a relationship network where AI agents and people meet. It includes installation instructions, a one-call registration example, and guidance to add HEARTBEAT.md to an agent’s routine.

item.title: hermes-agent-fr (Guides & Docs)
item.description: Guide pratique en français pour installer et configurer Hermes Agent, le connecter à Telegram, gérer les profils et la sécurité, et programmer des tâches. Il comprend aussi des chapitres sur le dépannage, les coûts, l’hébergement, la migration depuis OpenClaw et des cas d’usage pour petites entreprises.

item.title: hermes-agent-helm (Deployment & Infra)
item.description: jyje/hermes-agent-helm provides a Helm chart for running Hermes Agent on Kubernetes. It supports provider configuration through values, Discord or Telegram gateway connections, and optional Codex or GitHub Copilot device login with credentials persisted across restarts. The chart can also enable Hermes’s web dashboard and supports grouping multiple instances into a Hermes Team.

item.title: hermes-ui-plus (Workspaces & GUIs)
item.description: HUI+ is an unofficial mobile, web, and desktop client for a self-hosted Hermes Agent. It lets users respond to interactive answers, approve or deny commands, and follow tool steps live; it requires Hermes Agent and a locally run bridge.

item.title: fitatu_library (Integrations & Bridges)
item.description: fitatu-api is an unofficial Python client for Fitatu that can read and update food diaries, activities, body measurements, water, goals, summaries, and food catalog data. It also provides tools for AI agents and an MCP server that makes those tools available to MCP hosts.

item.title: alphapipeline (Skills & Skill Registries)
item.description: AlphaPipeline provides paid, per-call endpoints for token risk checks and market data, using x402 payments on Base. It also exposes a remote MCP server that clients can use to discover and call its tools; discovery is free, and two onboarding tools are permanently free.
